name: microdrama
description: Precision AI live-action video architecture & prompt engineering system — vertical microdrama series, short films, single scenes or trailers. Plans through 7 gated workflows with 3 approvals, enforces 25 static & semantic invariants (camera delta, lip-sync pacing, cliché filtering, token bijection, multi-location continuity), generates an interactive HTML Production Board, and provides ffmpeg-backed post-generation clip dissection.
